promises.label: FY26 revenue growth guidance 15%
promises.quote: We expect the customary ramp-up in project execution during Q4 and are reasonably confident of achieving our full year revenue growth guidance of 15%.
promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

promises.label: FY26 order inflow to exceed 10% growth
promises.quote: Basis the 9-month performance and the healthy prospects pipeline for the near term, we will be exceeding the 10% order inflow guidance for FY '26.
promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

promises.label: P&M EBITDA margin 8.5% FY26
promises.quote: Our Projects & Manufacturing EBITDA at 7.9% for 9 months of the current year is in line with the target that we have set ourselves at 8.5% for the full year FY '26.
promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

promises.label: NWC to revenue ~10% by March 2026
promises.quote: our Net Working Capital to Revenue has improved sharply to 8.2% as of December '25, and we expect to close the year with a revised target of around 10%.
promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

promises.label: Hydrocarbon margin recovery in 2-3 quarters
promises.quote: I expect Hydrocarbon business to come back on full strength maybe 2 or 3 quarters from now.
promises.speaker: Subramanian Sarma

promises.label: Kuwait tenders out and awarded this year
promises.quote: we are very positive that all of these tenders will be out by this calendar year, and they'll get awarded this year.
promises.speaker: Subramanian Sarma

promises.label: FY27 guidance in May
promises.quote: We should be in a better position to give you a guidance for FY '27 and beyond sometime in May.
promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

promises.label: ROE target 18% Lakshya plan
promises.quote: broadly in line with the target of 18% that we have set ourselves to during this last year, that is FY '26 for the Lakshya plan.
promises.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

reported.label: Highest ever quarterly order inflow Rs 1,356 billion
reported.quote: We witnessed our highest ever quarterly order inflows in Q3 FY '26 of Rs 1,356 billion, recording a 17% growth year-on-year
reported.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

reported.label: Group revenue Rs 714 billion, up 10%
reported.quote: Our group revenues for Q3 FY '26 stood at Rs 714 billion, registering a Y-on-Y growth of 10%
reported.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

reported.label: Group EBITDA margin 10.4% ex other income
reported.quote: Our group level EBITDA margin, excluding other income for Q3 FY'26 is 10.4% as compared to 9.7% in Q3 of the previous year.
reported.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

reported.label: Recurring PAT Rs 44 billion, up 31%
reported.quote: Our Recurring PAT at Rs 44 billion reported a strong growth of 31% Y-on-Y.
reported.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

reported.label: Reported PAT Rs 32 billion, down 4%
reported.quote: The reported PAT for Q3 FY '26 was at Rs 32 billion, down by 4% Y-o-Y, owing to a onetime impact of Rs 11.9 billion arising from the new Labour Codes regulation.
reported.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

reported.label: Order book Rs 7.33 trillion, up 30%
reported.quote: The order book is at Rs 7.33 trillion as on December '25 and up 30% as compared to December '24.
reported.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

reported.label: NWC to revenue improved to 8.2%
reported.quote: Our NWC to Sales ratio has improved from 12.7% in December '24 to 8.2% in December '25
reported.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan

reported.label: ROE 16.5%, up 40 bps
reported.quote: trailing 12-month Return on Equity for Q3 FY '26 is 16.5% as compared to 16.1% in Q3 of the previous year, an improvement of 40 basis points.
reported.speaker: P. Ramakrishnan
